	setarray .fx_nm$[4504], "VIOLENTQUAKE_VIOLENTQUAKE_CAST_BOTTOM_MIN_VIOLENTQUAKE_CAST_BOTTOM", "VIOLENTQUAKE_VIOLENTQUAKE_CAST_BOTTOM", "VIOLENTQUAKE_VIOLENTQUAKE_HIT", "WATER_SPLASH", "WE_CHEERUP", "WE_ONEFOREVER", "WEAKNESS", "WEAPON_PERFECTION";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4512], "WEAPONPERFECTION", "WEAPONPERFECTION_MIN", "WIDE_CRITICAL_WOUND", "WIDEB", "WINDHAWK_CALAMITYGALE_CALUMITYGALE", "WINDHAWK_CALAMITYGALE_CALUMITYGALE_MIN_CALUMITYGALE", "WINDHAWK_CALAMITYGALE_CALUMITYGALE_CAST", "WINDHAWK_CALAMITYGALE_CALUMITYGALE_CAST_MIN_CALUMITYGALE_CAST";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4520], "WINDHAWK_CALAMITYGALE_CALUMITYGALE_LOOP", "WINDHAWK_CALAMITYGALE_CALUMITYGALE_LOOP_MIN_CALUMITYGALE_LOOP", "WINDHAWK_CRESCIVE_BOLT_CRESCIVEBOLT", "WINDHAWK_CRESCIVE_BOLT_CRESCIVEBOLT_MIN_CRESCIVEBOLT", "WINDHAWK_CRESCIVE_BOLT_CRESCIVEBOLT_CAST", "WINDHAWK_CRESCIVE_BOLT_CRESCIVEBOLT_CAST_MIN_CRESCIVEBOLT_CAST", "WINDHAWK_CRESCIVE_BOLT_CRESCIVEBOLT_HIT", "WINDHAWK_CRESCIVE_BOLT_CRESCIVEBOLT_HIT_MIN_CRESCIVEBOLT_HIT";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4528], "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_MIN_WILD_WALK", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_CAST_MIN_WILD_WALK_CAST", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_CAST", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_CAST_BOTTOM_MIN_WILD_WALK_CAST_BOTTOM", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_CAST_BOTTOM", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_HIT_MIN_WILD_WALK_HIT", "WINDHAWK_WH_WILD_WALK_WILD_WALK_HIT";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4536], "WINDHIT", "WINDHIT1", "WINDHIT2", "WINDHIT3", "WINDSIGN_MIN_WINDSIGN", "WINDSIGN", "WINDSIGN_WINDSIGN_LOOP", "WL_TELEKINESIS_INTENSE_2";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4544], "WOODEN_FAIRY_FAIRY_DUSTY", "WOODEN_FAIRY_FAIRY_DUSTY_MIN_FAIRY_DUSTY", "WOODEN_FAIRY_WOODEN_CAST_MIN_WOODEN_CAST", "WOODEN_FAIRY_WOODEN_CAST", "WOODEN_FAIRY_WOODEN_CAST_BOTTOM_MIN_WOODEN_CAST_BOTTOM", "WOODEN_FAIRY_WOODEN_CAST_BOTTOM", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_THROWROCK_MIN_THROWROCK", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_THROWROCK";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4552], "WOODEN_WARRIOR_THROWROCK_THROWROCK_HIT_MIN_THROWROCK_HIT", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_THROWROCK_THROWROCK_HIT", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_ATTACK_MIN_WOODEN_ATTACK", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_ATTACK", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_ATTACK_WOODEN_ATTACK_HIT_MIN_WOODEN_ATTACK_HIT", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_ATTACK_WOODEN_ATTACK_HIT", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_WARRIOR_CAST_MIN_WOODEN_WARRIOR_CAST", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_WARRIOR_CAST";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4560], "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_WARRIOR_CAST_BOTTOM_MIN_WOODEN_WARRIOR_CAST_BOTTOM", "WOODEN_WARRIOR_WOODEN_WARRIOR_CAST_BOTTOM", "YUNTA_1", "YUNTA_2", "YUNTA_3", "YUNTA_4", "YUNTA_5", "2021RTC_HEADSET_1_TW_HDG";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4568], "2021RTC_HEADSET_3_TW_HDG", "ADO", "ALLBLOOM_ALLBLOOM_CAST_BOTTM_ALLBLOOM_CAST_BOTTOM", "ALLBLOOM_ALLBLOOM_CAST_BOTTM_MIN_ALLBLOOM_CAST_BOTTOM", "AURA", "AURASVIP_NEW_JUDEX_NEW_JUDEX_TARGET_BOTTOM", "DRUID_DR_RETURN_RETURN_MIN_RETURN", "DRUID_KR_NATURE_PROTECTION_NATURE_PROTECTION_MIN_NATURE_PROTECTION";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4576], "FROM_THE_ABYSS_FROM_THE_ABYSS_HIT_MIN_FROM_THE_ABYSS_HIT", "HAWKRUSH_MIN_HAWKRUSH", "KR_AWAKENING", "KR_BERSERK", "KR_BLUE_POTION", "KR_BULLS_EYE", "KR_CHAIN_RING", "KR_CONCENTRATION";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4584], "KR_CRESCENT_MOON2", "KR_DISPELL", "KR_DOKKAEBI_FIRE_STRANGELIGHTS", "KR_GREEN_POTION", "KR_HAZY_MOONLIGHT2", "KR_IGNITION_BREAK", "KR_MAGIC_ROAD", "KR_MOCHI";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4592], "KR_OMINOUS_RED_MOONLIGHT", "KR_PERSON_EFFECT", "KR_RED_POTION", "KR_SCARLET_POTION", "KR_SHADOW_OF_VOID", "KR_SOUL_BURN", "KR_SPELL_DEPLOY2", "KR_SPELL_DEPLOY3";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4600], "KR_SPELL_DEPLOY4", "KR_SPELL_DEPLOY5", "KR_SPELL_RELEASE", "KR_TRACKING", "KR_WHITE_POTION", "KR_YELLOW_POTION", "MINEFFECT_NEW_ARMSCANNON_NEW_ARMSCANNON_01_CLOCK_DOWN_NEW_ARMSCANNON_01_DOWN", "NEW_ARMSCANNON_NEW_ARMSCANNON_01_CLOCK_DOWN_NEW_ARMSCANNON_01_DOWN";
	setarray .fx_nm$[4608], "SPELL_ENCHANTING_MIN_SPELL_ENCHANTING", "STORMCANNON_STORMCANNON_CAST_MIN_STORMCANNON_CAST", "STORMCANNON_STORMCANNON_CAST_BOTTOM_MIN_STORMCANNON_CAST_BOTTOM", "STORMCANNON_STORMCANNON_CAST_BOTTOM", "STORMCANNON_STORMCANNON_HIT_MIN_STORMCANNON_HIT", "VIOLENTQUAKE_VIOLENTQUAKE_BOTTOM_VIOLENTQUAKE_CAST_BOTTOM", "VIOLENTQUAKE_VIOLENTQUAKE_HIT_MIN_VIOLENTQUAKE_HIT", "WINDSIGN_WINDTARGET_LOOP_MIN_WINDSIGN_LOOP";
	.fx_n = getarraysize(.fx_id);
	bindatcmd "hatfx", "HatFxViewer::OnCmd";
	end;

OnCmd:
	if (getgroupid() < .min_group) {
		dispbottom "ไม่มีสิทธิ์ใช้งาน";
		end;
	}
	if (.@atcmd_numparameters >= 1) {
		if (.@atcmd_parameters$[0] == "off") {
			if (@hfx_cur) hateffect @hfx_cur, 0;
			@hfx_cur = 0;
			dispbottom "ปิดเอฟเฟกต์พรีวิวแล้ว";
			end;
		}
		.@id = atoi(.@atcmd_parameters$[0]);
		if (.@id < 1 || .@id >= 12000) {
			dispbottom "รหัสเอฟเฟกต์ไม่ถูกต้อง";
			end;
		}
		if (@hfx_cur) hateffect @hfx_cur, 0;
		@hfx_cur = .@id;
		hateffect .@id, 1;
		dispbottom "แสดงเอฟเฟกต์ " + .@id;
		end;
	}
	.@i = 0;
	if (@hfx_cur) {
		for (.@k = 0; .@k < .fx_n; .@k++) {
			if (.fx_id[.@k] == @hfx_cur) {
				.@i = .@k;
				break;
			}
		}
	}
	while (1) {
		if (@hfx_cur) hateffect @hfx_cur, 0;
		@hfx_cur = .fx_id[.@i];
		hateffect @hfx_cur, 1;
		mes " ";
		clear;
		setdialogsize 560, 340;
		setdialogalign DIALOG_ALIGN_LEFT;
		mes "^7E22CE== HAT EFFECT VIEWER ==^000000";
		mes "ลำดับ " + (.@i + 1) + " / " + .fx_n;
		mes "รหัส: ^1E3A8A" + @hfx_cur + "^000000";
		mes "ชื่อ: ^0F766E" + .fx_nm$[.@i] + "^000000";
		.@s = select("ถัดไป (+1)", "ก่อนหน้า (-1)", "ข้าม +10", "ย้อน -10", "ข้าม +100", "ย้อน -100", "ไปที่รหัสเอฟเฟกต์", "ค้นหาจากชื่อ (ถัดไปที่ตรง)", "ไปหมวด", "ปิดเอฟเฟกต์แล้วออก", "ออก (คงเอฟเฟกต์ไว้)");
		switch (.@s) {
		case 1: .@i += 1; break;
		case 2: .@i -= 1; break;
		case 3: .@i += 10; break;
		case 4: .@i -= 10; break;
		case 5: .@i += 100; break;
		case 6: .@i -= 100; break;
		case 7:
			mes " ";
			clear;
			mes "พิมพ์รหัสเอฟเฟกต์ที่ต้องการ (จะข้ามไปรหัสที่ใกล้ที่สุดในรายการ)";
			input .@want, 0, 12000;
			.@i = 0;
			while (.@i < .fx_n - 1 && .fx_id[.@i] < .@want)
				{ .@i++; if (!(.@i % 300)) sleep2 1; }
			break;
		case 8:
			mes " ";
			clear;
			mes "พิมพ์ส่วนของชื่อ (ภาษาอังกฤษ เช่น DRAGON, ANGEL, FIRE)";
			input .@q$;
			.@q$ = strtoupper(.@q$);
			.@found = -1;
			for (.@k = 1; .@k <= .fx_n; .@k++) {
				.@j = (.@i + .@k) % .fx_n;
				if (!(.@k % 300)) sleep2 1;
				if (compare(.fx_nm$[.@j], .@q$)) {
					.@found = .@j;
					break;
				}
			}
			if (.@found < 0) {
				mes " ";
				clear;
				mes "ไม่พบชื่อที่มีคำว่า " + .@q$;
				next;
			} else
				.@i = .@found;
			break;
		case 9:
			mes " ";
			clear;
			mes "เลือกหมวด";
			.@c = select("เดิมของไคลเอนต์ (1-242)", "Spirit (500+)", "Aura (1000+)", "VIP Aura (2000+)", "VIP Aura 2 (3000+)", "Rank (3500+)", "เอฟเฟกต์ที่เพิ่มทั้งหมด (4000+)");
			.@want = 1;
			if (.@c == 2) .@want = 500;
			if (.@c == 3) .@want = 1000;
			if (.@c == 4) .@want = 2000;
			if (.@c == 5) .@want = 3000;
			if (.@c == 6) .@want = 3500;
			if (.@c == 7) .@want = 4000;
			.@i = 0;
			while (.@i < .fx_n - 1 && .fx_id[.@i] < .@want)
				{ .@i++; if (!(.@i % 300)) sleep2 1; }
			break;
		case 10:
			hateffect @hfx_cur, 0;
			@hfx_cur = 0;
			close;
		default:
			close;
		}
		if (.@i < 0) .@i += .fx_n;
		if (.@i >= .fx_n) .@i -= .fx_n;
		if (.@i < 0) .@i = 0;
	}
	end;
}
